# RDJ Publishers

> RDJ Publishers is a free, no-sign-up collection of browser-based tools, games, and productivity utilities for students and everyday users. Every tool runs entirely client-side — nothing is uploaded to a server.

RDJ Publishers is a small, independent web studio based in Tamil Nadu, India. All tools are free forever, require no login, and work instantly in the browser.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://rdjpublishers.com/): Full directory of tools, games, and utilities by category
- [About](https://rdjpublishers.com/about.html): Who RDJ Publishers is and why the site exists
- [Contact](https://rdjpublishers.com/contact.html): Get in touch with the team
- [Sitemap](https://rdjpublishers.com/sitemap.html): Full list of live projects
- [Privacy Policy](https://rdjpublishers.com/privacy-policy.html)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://rdjpublishers.com/terms.html)

## Tools & Apps

- [Digital Calculator](https://rdjpublishers.com/digital_calculator/): Free online calculator
- [3D Model Viewer](https://rdjpublishers.com/3d-model-viewer/): View 3D models in the browser
- [Prompt Gallery](https://rdjpublishers.com/Prompt-Gallery/): Browse and copy AI prompts
- [Attendance Calculator](https://rdjpublishers.com/attendance-calculator/): Calculate class attendance percentage
- [Chess Game](https://rdjpublishers.com/Chess-Game/): Play chess in the browser
- [Chess Editor](https://rdjpublishers.com/Chess-Editor/): Set up and edit chess positions
- [QR Scanner](https://rdjpublishers.com/QR-Scanner/): Scan QR codes using your camera
- [PDF Toolkit](https://rdjpublishers.com/Pdf-Toolkit/): Merge, split, and edit PDF files
- [ChromaCut](https://rdjpublishers.com/ChromaCut/): Background removal / color tool
- [Image Splitter](https://rdjpublishers.com/Image-Splitter/): Split images into grids
- [Colour Picker](https://rdjpublishers.com/Colour-Picker/): Pick and copy colour codes
- [Grammar Checker](https://rdjpublishers.com/Grammar-Checker/): Check grammar in text
- [Wordly Game](https://rdjpublishers.com/Wordly-Game/): Word-guessing game
- [Touch to Music](https://rdjpublishers.com/Touch-Music/): Interactive music tool
- [RDJ Blogs](https://rdjpublishers.com/blogs/): Articles and guides from RDJ Publishers

## Notes

- All tools are 100% free, require no account, and process data locally in the browser.
- Optional: See [sitemap.xml](https://rdjpublishers.com/sitemap.xml) for full crawl metadata.
